name: ve-so-do
description: Generate, validate, and render UML analysis/design diagrams for the supermarket sales-management exam. AI agents should call this CLI from the project root using zsh/bash.

tools.name: validate_diagrams
tools.description: Validate one JSON definition containing one diagram or a diagrams array.

tools.name: generate_sources
tools.description: Generate one .puml source per diagram, or Markdown for scenario definitions.

tools.name: render_diagrams
tools.description: Generate .puml sources then render PNG/SVG using vendored plantuml.jar. Preferred tool when image files are required.

output_dir.description: Directory to receive generated image and .puml files

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: List built-in diagrams matching the exam questions.
